findings.note: She is the lead presenter of S.505, An Act establishing same day voter registration. The bill would let an eligible person register in person at the polling place or an early voting site by showing proof of residence (a valid photo ID, or a document such as a utility bill, bank statement or lease) and signing a citizenship oath under penalty of perjury. A person with no proof of residence may cast a provisional ballot and must bring proof within 2 business days after a primary or 6 days after an election. Date is when the Senate sent it to the Election Laws committee. The Election Laws committee reported it favorably on 2025-11-24 and it was referred to Senate Ways and Means.
